sql.SQL: SELECT fv.business_party_dl_code AS fv_business_party_dl_code, fv.business_party_dl_title AS fv_business_party_dl_title, SUM(fv.debit) - SUM(fv.credit) AS balance FROM financial_vouchers AS fv WHERE fv.voucher_date >= $1 AND fv.business_party_dl_title IS NOT NULL GROUP BY fv.business_party_dl_code, fv.business_party_dl_title HAVING SUM(fv.debit) - SUM(fv.credit) > $2 ORDER BY balance DESC

question: طرف‌های تجاری با مانده بستانکار از ابتدای سال

sql.SQL: SELECT fv.business_party_dl_code AS fv_business_party_dl_code, fv.business_party_dl_title AS fv_business_party_dl_title, SUM(fv.debit) - SUM(fv.credit) AS balance FROM financial_vouchers AS fv WHERE fv.voucher_date >= $1 AND fv.business_party_dl_title IS NOT NULL GROUP BY fv.business_party_dl_code, fv.business_party_dl_title HAVING SUM(fv.debit) - SUM(fv.credit) < $2 ORDER BY balance ASC

question: گردش ارزی به تفکیک نوع ارز از ابتدای سال

question: عملکرد صادرکنندگان سند از ابتدای سال

question: گردش حساب معین خاص به تفکیک تفصیل از ابتدای سال

question: اسناد با شماره پیگیری خاص

question: اسناد با شرح خاص از ابتدای سال

question: گردش کالا به تفکیک کد کالا از ابتدای سال

sql.SQL: SELECT fv.part_dl_code AS fv_part_dl_code, fv.part_dl_title AS fv_part_dl_title, SUM(fv.debit) AS fv_debit_sum, SUM(fv.credit) AS fv_credit_sum, SUM(fv.quantity) AS fv_quantity_sum FROM financial_vouchers AS fv WHERE fv.voucher_date >= $1 AND fv.part_dl_title IS NOT NULL GROUP BY fv.part_dl_code, fv.part_dl_title ORDER BY fv_debit_sum DESC

question: مجموع گردش بدهکار سال جاری و سال قبل

sql.SQL: SELECT (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(fv.debit), 0) FROM financial_vouchers AS fv WHERE fv.voucher_date >= $1 AND fv.voucher_date <= $2) AS current_year_debit, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(fv.debit), 0) FROM financial_vouchers AS fv WHERE fv.voucher_date >= $3 AND fv.voucher_date <= $4) AS previous_year_debit

question: مقایسه تعداد اسناد سال جاری با سال قبل

sql.SQL: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(fv.voucher_number) FROM financial_vouchers AS fv WHERE fv.voucher_date >= $1 AND fv.voucher_date <= $2) AS current_year_count, (SELECT COUNT(fv.voucher_number) FROM financial_vouchers AS fv WHERE fv.voucher_date >= $3 AND fv.voucher_date <= $4) AS previous_year_count

question: اسناد با گردش بدهکار میلیونی بالا از ابتدای سال

question: ده طرف تجاری با بیشترین مانده بدهکار از ابتدای سال

question: مقایسه گردش هفته جاری با هفته گذشته به تفکیک نوع سند

sql.SQL: SELECT A.voucher_type_title AS voucher_type_title, A.this_week_debit AS this_week_debit, B.last_week_debit AS last_week_debit FROM (SELECT fv.voucher_type_title AS voucher_type_title, SUM(fv.debit) AS this_week_debit FROM financial_vouchers AS fv WHERE fv.voucher_date >= $1 AND fv.voucher_date <= $2 GROUP BY fv.voucher_type_title) AS A LEFT JOIN (SELECT fv.voucher_type_title AS voucher_type_title, SUM(fv.debit) AS last_week_debit FROM financial_vouchers AS fv WHERE fv.voucher_date >= $3 AND fv.voucher_date <= $4 GROUP BY fv.voucher_type_title) AS B ON A.voucher_type_title = B.voucher_type_title
